# Frozen recall regression source

`formation-16153a5f.py.gz` contains the exact public repository source bytes of
`src/agent_core/memory/distillation.py` at commit
`16153a5f4066df2c1753fbb10f41b435dae81f81`. It is a deterministic gzip member
with an uncompressed SHA-256 of `e7ce0e0f0e93f2279126ba8a7d6f9e554222c22f2c9fd074836ed48c2bad6823`.

The formation-repair tests compare this original source with the repaired module
and reject changes to requests, parsing and other behavior. Keeping the original
bytes here makes those same assertions work in shallow clones and source archives,
without fetching unrelated history. This contains no evaluation rows, private
logs, credentials or human judgments, and does not change the measured runtime.
